create_AtariDQNNet: create an AtariDQNNet with a Nature or Impala CNN backbone and Dueling or standard DQN head
build_AtariDQNModel: build an AtariDQNModel with configurable network type, dueling DQN, spectral norm, and double DQN options
test_AtariDQNModel_act: test the AtariDQNModel act method to sample epsilon-greedy actions from observation tensors
review_AtariDQNModel_q: review the AtariDQNModel q method to gather Q-values for specific state-action pairs
refactor_AtariDQNModel_sync_target_net: refactor the AtariDQNModel sync_target_net method to update target network weights from the online network
